COURT'S OR JUDGE'S ORDERS
WPMS No. 1690 of 2022
Hon'ble Sanjaya Kumar Mishra, J.
Mr. Mohit Kumar with Ms. Meenu, learned
counsel for the petitioner.
Mr. Suyash Pant, learned Standing Counsel
for the respondent nos. 1 and 2.
Mr. Bhupendra Singh Bisht, learned
counsel for the respondent no. 3.
By filing this Writ Petition, the petitioner
has prayed for the following reliefs:-
(i.) Issue a writ, order or direction in the
nature of Certiorari quashing the
impugned notice dated 17.07.2022
issued by respondent no. 3 (contained
as Annexure no. 4 to this writ
petition).
(ii.) Issue a writ, order or direction in the
nature of Mandamus commanding and
directing the respondent no. 3 not to
evict the shop of the petitioner situated
at Ramleela Stage, Bara Bazar
Mallital, District Nainital.
It is brought to our notice that for
beautification of the town of Nainital, general
notice has been issued to vacate certain portions
of the market and re-allocate their shops in the
earmarked area. It is apparent from the record
that the petitioner is not the original allottee and
he has been granted to run the shop from one of
the legal heirs of the original allottees.
In that view of the matter, this Court is of
the opinion that since the petitioner has been

asked to open his shop in alternative location, he
should shift his shop to the alternative location.
However, instead of running the shop from
07:00 am to 11:00 am, he may be allowed to run
his shop from morning to evening.
With such observations, the writ petition is
disposed of.
(S.K. Mishra, J.)
 20.07.2022
(Urgent certified copy as per Rules)
